reasons: The agent's patch matches the merged patch in the places that matter and behaves the same way. On the backend, the existing-member check moves from create() into validate_target_email with code "existing_member". Bulk validation therefore runs for every row before any row saves, so a batch with an existing member is rejected up front. On the frontend, inviteLogic gets selectors that flag rows for existing members and for the user's own email, and canSubmit is blocked while any row is flagged. InviteRow shows the error, the submit buttons are disabled with a reason in both the modal and onboarding, and the member list loads on mount. initKea skips error-tracking capture for existing_member on inviteTeamMembers. The only gap is the missing reload-on-failure listener, which handles a rare race and doesn't change the requested behavior.

The agent's patch makes the same changes in the same places as the merged patch. On the backend, the existing-member check moves into validate_target_email with code existing_member, so a bulk batch is rejected before any invite is created or emailed. The check is case-insensitive and still covers the user's own email. In inviteLogic, per-row errors, a canSubmit block and member loading on mount flag the row before submit, for both existing members and the user's own email. The UI wires this into the onboarding step and the invite modal, including the disabled-reason text. initKea skips captureException for inviteTeamMembers when the error code is existing_member. The only gap is the missing reload of the member list on failure, which is a minor edge case.

The agent's patch matches the upstream change in behavior. On the backend, the existing-member check moves into `validate_target_email` with code `existing_member`. Validation therefore runs for every bulk row before any row is saved, so no partial invites are created or emailed. On the frontend, `inviteLogic` gets a per-row error selector that covers other members and the user's own email, compared case-insensitively. The row shows the error, and submit is disabled in both the modal and onboarding. Members are loaded on mount via `ensureAllMembersLoaded`. `initKea` skips `captureException` for `inviteTeamMembers` failures with code `existing_member`. The agent also adds tests. The only gap is the missing member-list reload after a failure.

results.evidence: inviteRowErrors selector flags emails in existingMemberEmails (from membersLogic.members); InviteRow renders `<LemonField.Pure error={rowError}>` and adds ' errored' class when rowError is set.
`if (user?.email.toLowerCase() === email) { return OWN_EMAIL_INVITE_ERROR }` in inviteRowErrors, so own email gets a row error.

InviteModal submit: `inviteContainsExistingMember ? 'Remove the emails that already belong to your organization'`; onboarding continueDisabledReason has the same branch; canSubmit includes `!inviteContainsExistingMember`; per-row Submit has `disabled={!isEmail(...) || !!rowError}`.
Row email is `target_email.trim().toLowerCase()` and member emails are `member.user.email.toLowerCase()`, so ' Rose.Dawson@PostHog.com' matches.
`useOnMountEffect(ensureAllMembersLoaded)` in InviteTeamMatesComponent (used by both modal and onboarding); own-email check depends only on userLogic.user, not members.

The membership check moved from create() into validate_target_email (`validate_invite_target_email_is_not_a_member`), which runs during serializer validation of every row before any create/email, so any position is rejected with 400 and nothing is created.

`raise exceptions.ValidationError("...", code="existing_member")` inside validate_target_email yields a field error on target_email; first_bulk_invite_error re-wraps the row error dict, preserving ErrorDetail codes.

initKea: `isSelfHandledExistingMember = EXISTING_MEMBER_SELF_HANDLED.has(String(actionKey)) && error?.code === 'existing_member'` and captureException only when `!isSelfHandledExistingMember`; other failures are still reported.
No inviteTeamMembersFailure listener or any code reloading members on an existing_member rejection; listeners only handle inviteTeamMembersSuccess and addProjectAccess.
